source.author: verg
source.text: Hinc, ubi iam firmata virum te fecerit aetas, cedet et ipse mari vector, nec nautica pinus mutabit merces: omnis feret omnia tellus:
source.text_original: Hinc, ubi iam firmata virum te fecerit aetas, / cedet et ipse mari vector, nec nautica pinus / mutabit merces: omnis feret omnia tellus: /
source.text_english: Then, when maturity has already made you a man, the sailor himself will also give way to the sea, and the pine of the ship will not change its cargo: every land will bear everything.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: cum uero deletis religionibus impiis et scelere compresso subiecta erit deo terra, cedet et ipse mari uector nec nautica pinus mutabit merces, omnis feret omnia tellus.
reuse.text_original: cum uero deletis religionibus impiis et scelere compresso subiecta erit deo terra, cedet et ipse mari uector nec nautica pinus mutabit merces, omnis feret omnia tellus.
reuse.text_english: But when the impious religions have been destroyed and crime has been suppressed, and the earth has been brought under God, the seafarer too will yield to the sea, and the pine ship will no longer change its cargo; the whole earth will bear everything.
